title: Rank-one ledger of paired symbols
summary: Each symbol writes the outer product of two projections into a square ledger, and a later symbol reads the ledger with a dot product against its own projection.
core_idea: A square ledger built from outer products of symbol projections and read by dot products.

state.name: velarin
state.meaning: Square ledger holding the sum of outer products of the projections of every symbol read.

learning.description: The projections a, b and c are fixed random matrices.
learning.few_shot_argument: Fixture only: no claim about learning speed is made beyond the toy case.

complexity.constants_notes: A handful of operations per symbol in the toy setting.

sample_efficiency.mechanism: Fixture only: the rule is fixed by hand.

prediction.statement: One write suffices to read a pair back.

known_relatives.name: not assessed
known_relatives.relation: Sums of outer products appear in many retrieval schemes.
known_relatives.claimed_difference: Fixture only; no difference is claimed.

falsifiers: Accuracy below 0.5 with four stored pairs.
The ledger norm shrinks after a write.

toy_example.description: One rank-one write and its trace.
toy_example.python:
import json
a = [1.0, 2.0]
b = [0.5, -1.0]
m = [[a[i] * b[j] for j in range(2)] for i in range(2)]
print(json.dumps({'trace': m[0][0] + m[1][1], 'corner': m[0][1]}))
